about: Authoring data for the ForestFire map (a copy of ForestSAR). A fire came up the steep valley to the east and has burnt the forest east of an irregular front 70-130 m east of the start. tools/burn_mask.py turns burn_polygon_ne into burn_mask.png, which the landscape material (burnt ground) and the forest graph (charred trees, no understory) both read. The fires themselves are not part of the map: scenarios list them (fires), and fire_points_ne are suggestions for that.
frame: NED metres from the Unreal origin (north, east); the landscape spans -504..504 m on both axes

mask.layout: pixel [row, col] = [east, north]: row 0 is east -504 m, col 0 is north -504 m; value 128 + 127 b, b = burnt (0..1), never 0 (see tools/burn_mask.py)
